purpose: Provide the shared character animation driver used by player and infected scenes.

animation_selection_v1.configure_clip_selector: configure_clip_selector(selector: Callable) -> void; selector() -> StringName; optional local playback selection, no gameplay state

animation_events_v1.play_one_shot: play_one_shot(state: StringName) -> float; states attack|death|death_forward|death_back|slam|summon (slam/summon need a matching skeletal clip; directional deaths fall back to Death, ADR-0034), returns clip length or 0.0 (death is final)
animation_events_v1.notify_hit: notify_hit(world_point: Vector3 = ZERO, world_direction: Vector3 = ZERO, strength: float = 1.0) -> void; skeletal models twist/rock the torso away from the hit with a damped spring, hips and legs keep the clip (hit_reaction_v1, ADR-0040); no direction rocks back; models without a spine bone flinch as a whole
animation_events_v1.set_active: set_active(active: bool) -> void; pauses animation for distant characters
animation_events_v1.play_dodge: play_dodge(world_direction: Vector3, duration: float) -> bool; plays the roll (whole hips clip, body turns along the dodge) or the strafe jump (dodge_style 0/1) over duration; false without leg_clips (ADR-0044)
animation_events_v1.play_named_one_shot: play_named_one_shot(clip: StringName, blend := 0.12, speed := 1.0, leg_clip := "") -> float; plays a clip by name once, emits one_shot_finished(clip), returns its duration; with leg_clip a moving character keeps that locomotion clip on its legs meanwhile (ADR-0045)
animation_events_v1.play_overlay: play_overlay(clip: StringName) -> bool; plays a clip on the upper body only, over the running legs (ADR-0045)
animation_events_v1.attack_legs: an attack/attack_left/attack_right one-shot played while the character moves loops the run or walk clip on the leg bones only (leg_overlay.gd), the attack clip keeps the rest; released when the attack ends or the body stops (held 0.25 s across speed dips, dropped at once on death or set_active(false)); not used with leg_clips
animation_events_v1.play_strike: play_strike(kind: StringName) -> float; procedural melee pose over the playing clips, kind kick (right leg) or punch (left arm); returns its duration, 0.0 without the bones or when dead; is_striking() reports it (ADR-0066)
animation_events_v1.clip_meta: clip_meta(clip, key, default) -> Variant; clip_length(clip) -> float (ADR-0045)
animation_events_v1.prepare_visual: prepare_visual() -> void; idempotent rig/clip preparation; optional defer_setup=true before ready postpones it; set_active requests are preserved

animation_assets_v1.leg_playback_multiplier: @export float = 1.0, finite and clamped 0.5..2.0; scales only leg_clips locomotion after speed matching, live and before attachment; upper-body, one-shot and dodge clocks unchanged (ADR-0050)
animation_assets_v1.animation_library: @export AnimationLibrary; optional clip set replacing the model's own clips (ADR-0016)
animation_assets_v1.procedural_gait: @export bool; speed-synchronised leg gait layered over authored clips, presentation only (ADR-0016); knees bend in the plane the foot points along (ADR-0040)
animation_assets_v1.run_exit_ratio: @export float = 0.85; a running character keeps the run clip down to this share of run_speed_threshold (ADR-0040)
animation_assets_v1.extra_clips: @export AnimationLibrary; clips merged into the model's default library; metadata ref_speed (cycle pace, m/s) and strike_time (attack impact, s) are honoured (ADR-0045)
animation_assets_v1.leg_clips: @export AnimationLibrary; retargeted hips-and-legs clips (run in eight directions, Dodge_Roll, Dodge_Strafe_Left/Right) replacing the procedural gait; arms, shoulders and weapon hold stay authored (ADR-0044)
